title: The Pill That Banned Sleep Forever 💊 #Shorts #Animation
description:
I haven't slept in 365 days. A medical lab invented a blue pill that eliminated sleep, but then corporations made 20-hour workdays mandatory, and our un-dreamt nightmares started bleeding into broad daylight! Would you take the pill (Option A) or keep normal sleep (Option B)? Vote below!
